name: resilient-token-protocol
description: A Solana-native, self-funding treasury governed by a modular Rust swarm. Any token project adopts RTP — their trading fees route to the swarm, which autonomously researches, validates, and executes yield strategies (30K configs/night, 9-fold walk-forward validation, fee-aware simulation) — returning yield back to the project and its holders. Funded by its own yield, forever.
